description: This file contains unit tests for the CTR_DRBG (Counter mode Deterministic Random Byte Generator) implementation in BoringSSL, using Google Test framework. It tests initialization, reseeding, generation, large data handling, and test vectors.

methods.name: Basic
methods.description: Tests basic initialization, reseeding, and data generation of CTR_DRBG.

methods.name: Allocated
methods.description: Tests dynamic allocation of CTR_DRBG state.

methods.name: Large
methods.description: Tests generating a large amount of data and verifies the output hash.

methods.name: TestVectors
methods.description: Runs predefined test vectors from a file to verify CTR_DRBG correctness.
